Name: Spoiler-Free Gift Indicator
Author: TechnicalityCreations
Description:
When playing Stardew Valley, don't you ever wish for an easy way to find out loved gifts for the NPCs? Sure, you could use mods like LookupAnything, but they give you way to many spoilers and (at least for me) make you feel like cheating. On the other hand, you have the vanilla gift helper, which shows you everything that you've discovered, but is hard to pull up quickly, on the go. What if there was a mod that combined the convenience of LookupAnything, with the rewarding feel of discovering the gifts on your own? Introducing the [b]Spoiler-Free Gift Indicator[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37052/37052-1756283154-973004833.png[/img]
This mod shows you, out of the items in your inventory, which of them are loved gifts, in bubbles above NPC heads. However, it will only show you gifts that you've discovered, meaning it is actually feasible to play the game in a spoiler free manner! In addition, everything is fully configurable (with GMCM), from the opacity of the bubbles, to whether it will only show you gifts on an NPC's birthday! This mod is designed to be used in conjunction with the vanilla list, so you can plan what to get for each person and be reminded which gifts are for each person.

If you enjoy this mod, please endorse it; it means a lot to me and helps other people find it.
